name: career-coach
description: Evidence-grounded executive career direction, opportunity evaluation, and resume tailoring.

interface.shortDescription: Executive career decisions and resume tailoring
interface.longDescription: Clarify career direction, evaluate specific opportunities from both sides, and tailor resumes without inventing or overstating evidence.
defaultPrompt: Help me clarify what I should target next in my career.
Evaluate whether this opportunity fits me and whether I fit it.
Tailor my resume to this role using only supported facts.
